integrity: The attached standalone verifier reconstructs the face complex, proves triviality of a finite fundamental-group presentation through 52 legitimate Tietze steps, and checks all 136 signed affine traces. Ordinary finite checking is not external audit.
scientific_limitations: Single order-seventeen quadratic-residue graph; nonequivariant homotopy classification; rational (not integral) affine homology representation. Some underlying Betti information is already implied by published first-cohomology and clique-count results. Unindexed equivalent prior work remains a risk.
title: Paley-17 flag complex: sixteen 2-spheres and its affine homology representation
